plainSummary: Concurrent work retains distinct identities and migrated history remains traceable; organization publishing credentials are still unverified.
summary: Scoped code approval for implementation acceptance 1–3. Independent creation and migration killers exposed staged inventory injection, publication symlink escape, moving branch attribution, stale pending files, dangling authority references and waiver collision overwrite; unchanged behavior assertions passed after production fixes. Final combined ledger/UI-client adversarial run passed 188/188 (24 suites). Reconciled migration independently validates 3716 files and six attributed repairs; corrected waiver matches its historical review on turn, workstream and tree digest. Inspected all four declared current screenshots: titled desktop list, mobile details, honest experiments empty state, and workflow library with built-in default. Approval does not claim organization NPM_TOKEN configuration, authenticated npm publication or a completed external publishing requirement. A later contextual audit migration correction passed the nested-row ownership regression and the 51-criterion historical audit. The final release-tag workflow change passed all seven existing publish killers and an intercepted execution of the actual shell for dispatch prerelease, release prerelease and stable release. Final inspected screenshot files end in -final.jpg; no screenshot establishes external credential availability.
